description: This plot illustrates the relationship between Loss and Training Time (s) for two different configurations, one labeled "Vanilla" and another with a redacted label in the legend. The x-axis represents "Training Time (s)" on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 250000 with tick marks at regular intervals of 50000. The y-axis represents "Loss" on a linear scale, ranging from 2.40 to 2.75 with tick marks at intervals of 0.05. The plot features two solid lines that both exhibit a steep initial decline followed by a gradual leveling off. The "Vanilla" configuration is represented by a purple solid line with upward-pointing triangle markers; it begins above the y-axis maximum of 2.75 at the start of training and decreases steadily, ending at a value of exactly 2.50 at approximately 245000 seconds. The second configuration is depicted by a red solid line with circular markers; it also begins above 2.75, decreases more rapidly than the purple line, reaches a loss of 2.50 at approximately 195000 seconds, and ends at a loss of roughly 2.49 at approximately 235000 seconds. Additionally, the plot includes a horizontal green dashed line at a loss value of 2.50, intersecting both data lines at points marked with green stars. Vertical green dashed lines extend downward from these two intersection points to the x-axis, and a horizontal green double-headed arrow labeled "1.26×" spans the distance between these two vertical lines.
